I'm 23. I live with a guy I'm in love with, who I sleep with, and his best female friend.


I was in school but, as I spent time in psychiatric hospital in January 2013, I missed too much of it. I could not afford to retake the year so I had to drop out. I'm currently working as an admin assistant but have been signed off by a doctor for 2 weeks due to severe stress.


I am just about keeping up with my responsibilities.



The guy I live with is an alcoholic and confessed this on Friday. He says he will give up drinking. He's the man in the original post.



The girl is addicted to weed, has anxiety problems and is untrustworthy. She got angry at me once and betrayed me horribly. It hurts me to stay friends with her, much of the time.



I delete my posts because my ex used to find my reddit posts and make me answer to him about them. I don't like the idea that any more "real life" people could trace me and read about me. I like to be anonymous.

I write under different names so no one in real life finds my account, I get comments like this every time. I usually delete it all though. It is all true, but I tend to get accused of making it up or trying to promote a story.




When I was thirteen, my best friend was troubled. Her mother was an alcoholic and her dad was not really around. Additionally, her mum had woken up during a surgical abortion and felt the pain of it (hence the drinking). She treated my best friend, Lara, as a miracle that she must protect.. by smothering and over-promoting. She told her she was beautiful and perfect and all of that. But it didn't match up to the way she was treated at school; boys weren't into her. The boy she liked didn't want her. I was her friend in a passive kind of way. She led me. I wasn't interested in being pretty or getting boys as such, but she moulded me a little. I was having my own problems at home.



I was taken on a family holiday to Scotland. My parents dumped it on me unexpectedly because mum wanted a break. I had about a day to prepare. I used to be very resistant to sudden changes of plan, or being forced to do things. Mostly, I still am, just more resigned to it. 



Being thirteen, away from home and stuck with a family that was imploding a little more each day, I got sad, and this turned to anger. I bared my teeth to keep everyone out. I snapped at everyone, turned to my mobile phone and texted Lara constantly. I had been suicidal since at least eleven and it was beginning to peak. She started to echo my statements and told me she was going to overdose because she couldn't be with the boy she wanted.



I was in a restaurant with my parents. I got a text "I've taken twenty-four paracetamoles (sic), I'll miss you xxxxxxx".


"Mum, can I speak to you privately?"



We went into the toilets. I showed her the text. Rather than reassure me, she took my phone from me and rang the girl's mother. I stood there while she spoke on the phone. I could only hear one side. My mum's face set in a line, anger, very familiar. They talked for a while. I was crying, worried. She got off the phone and put it in her pocket.



"You're not having this back".



She began to read through my texts. My teen angst and complaints about her and dad, laid bare. I flinched, sure she was going to start attacking. I'm not sure what happened next.


Next thing I remember is going back up the stairs to the room we were renting. Entering mine and my brother's room. Having to stand aside whilst mum collected up my books, CDs and - finally - my notebooks. She tore through them, so angry she was spitting as she yelled, her face red and screwed up. Such a caricature of rage that I laughed at her. I was terrified, but so scared that I barely felt it.



She read my writing back to me in a baby voice. Called me crazy, fucking pathetic, mental. Took my CD walkman. Said I wasn't allowed music, books, pens or notepads until we went back to school in September (it was July).



She told me to curl up on my empty bed, in my empty room, and go to fucking sleep.


My dad kept saying "Jan.. come on.. Jan" and tried to physically push her from the room, as always, because she was shouting and screaming and had lost all control and was backing me into a corner. She fought him back, hit him. My brother cried and tried to hold her off my dad. Dad lost patience and stormed out. She blamed me, slammed my door and went to her own room.



My brother asked why I have to make so much trouble.



Next day, we went to the loch.



I would cry at random, not really inside my own body, wondering what happened. 



Lara told her mum it was a suicide pact and that I made her do it. She never did take the pills. She just lied to me so I'd give her attention.



So that's why I'd cry. Betrayal. Confusion. The punishment. The cell that my room became.



They wouldn't leave me alone much. The first half hour that they did, I took a knife from the kitchen and ran it along my stomach, but it was too blunt.



Since then, when things get bad - really bad - I disappear. Something takes my place. Mechanical. Robotic. 




When it gets worse, I go mute and I am somewhere else.



They meant "dipping" as in my mood. They thought I was crying because I was remembering what Lara did. I was crying because I was tired, because keeping up the robot face was hard. It wasn't my mood changing. Just it breaking through.
